overlays.notes: Measured on-chain 2026-07-14 at Ethereum block 25530791 via eth_call. The contract graph was derived on-chain from the LUSD token (troveManagerAddress(), stabilityPoolAddress(), then TroveManager.priceFeed()) rather than from a published address list. TroveManager.getTCR(PriceFeed.lastGoodPrice() = 1780.21673094 USD/ETH) returned 4.776, which cross-checks exactly against getEntireSystemColl() 73,493.400 ETH valued at that price ($130,834,180) over getEntireSystemDebt() 27,391,435.164 LUSD. StabilityPool.getTotalLUSDDeposits() of 7,627,015.234 LUSD over the same debt gives a liquidation capacity ratio of 0.278; LUSD totalSupply() equals getEntireSystemDebt() exactly at this block, so the ratio is identical against supply. checkRecoveryMode() was false, MCR 110%, CCR 150%. Collateralization parameters and liquidation mechanics are documented, immutable protocol design reviewed against the V1 docs. Backstop, branch isolation, shutdown/bad-debt, and structural redemption are left bounded-unknown pending a dedicated review, even though redistribution-to-Troves and permissionless redemption are documented features: the Stability Pool covers only 27.8% of system debt, and the redistribution fallback that absorbs the remainder has not been reviewed here.
